decisions.reason: As a newly launched dental-lab material with its own web page and a close fit to the firm's custom-device portfolio, it is likely to remain above a minimum aspiration level and the firm's size gives it slack to keep it.
This thermoforming blank is tightly aligned with the firm's dental workflow business and its dedicated presentation suggests enough initial commitment and expected demand to justify continuing it.

Because the UV-curing lacquer was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it likely sits closer to the aspiration threshold, but the firm's resources and innovation orientation still favor retaining it for now.
The intraoral contrast spray supports digital impression and scanning workflows central to the firm's strategy, and its own page indicates management sees it as a meaningful offering worth keeping.
The custom earmold line fits the firm's hearing-care customer base and manufacturing capabilities, so a large established firm would usually continue it unless results clearly disappointed.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are somewhat more niche and only lightly signaled on the website, but they are still adjacent to the firm's hearing expertise and likely kept while management learns about demand.
